what: The two directions of ONE mechanism, in one document. Flexible label matching is what lets a template work across form variants; it is also what would let a field be filled from a DIFFERENTLY LABELLED value carrying a plausible number. 'Shipping' must be filled from the document's 'Freight' line. 'Discount', 'Deposit Paid' and 'Retainage' are absent and must come back EMPTY - and the page is full of tempting substitutes, including a $0.00 that would look entirely reasonable in any of them.
